_comment: Two shipped pain-term sets. The agent should generate a fresh set per product/pain intake, but these show the shape + the pain-vs-solution discipline: every phrase is something a frustrated OPERATOR would type, never a solution/category keyword (those attract builders/VCs, not buyers). pain_regex catches the 'still doing X manually' family. Pass a set's pain_terms to search_pain_posts.py / pain_filter.py and the pain_regex via --pain-regex.
